description: Fixed-size ring buffer with head/tail pointer wraparound safety proof. Uses Z3 modular arithmetic. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/ring_buffer — verified circular buffer'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/container/safe_queue.mm and std/container/bounded_array.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm, safe_queue.mm, and bounded_array.mm already use.

atoms.name: ring_advance
atoms.description: Advance an index by one modulo the ring capacity. Proves the result is always within [0, cap) — the core wraparound invariant.

atoms.name: ring_push
atoms.description: Push an element onto a ring buffer that has spare room. Returns the new length. Requires the buffer to be non-full.

atoms.name: ring_pop
atoms.description: Pop the oldest element from a non-empty ring buffer. Returns the new length.

atoms.name: ring_is_empty
atoms.description: Return 1 when the ring buffer is empty, 0 otherwise.
